messages.subject: geom_point with stat_summary
parts:
Hi am plotting some time series with ggplot2 and it look slike this:

qplot(main="Title",ylim=yrange,xlim=xrange)+xlab("x label")
+ylab("y label")+
geom_point(data=TimeSeries1,aes(x=day,
y=value,colour="Series1"),size=1.0)+
geom_point(data=TimeSeries2,aes(x=day,
y=value,colour="Series2"),size=1.0)+
geom_point(data=TimeSeries3,aes(x=day,
y=value,colour="Series3"),size=1.0)+
geom_point(data=TimeSeries4,aes(x=day,
y=value,colour="Series4"),size=1.0)+
scale_colour_manual("Values",c("Series1" = "blue","Series2" =
"red","Series3" = "orange","Series1"="yellow"))
+opts(legend.position="right")

for each dataset (TimeSeries1,TimeSeries2,...) I would like to add the
average with line geometry.
I've found this, but it doesn't work and I can't understand why:

stat_summary(fun.y=mean, colour="red", geom="line")

or am I using the wrong option to do this?

Can someone help me with this?

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: geom_point with stat_summary
parts:
Since you already have two separate plots you could use the grid.arrange function
from the gridExtra package.
Something like this:
library(gridExtra)
a <- qplot(main="Title1",ylim=yrange,xlim=xrange)+xlab("x label")+ylab("y label")+

grid.arrange(a,b)
 
Alternatively, you can melt your data and then use either facet_grid() or facet_wrap()
